key.name: update-interval-ms
key.description: How often the top bar label is recalculated, in milliseconds.

key.name: averaging-window-ms
key.description: Time window over which presented frames are counted to compute the refresh rate, in milliseconds.

key.name: show-decimals
key.description: Show the refresh rate with two decimal places instead of rounding.

key.name: show-idle-rate
key.summary: Show the rest rate when idle
key.description: When the output is not being driven continuously, show the VRR floor (or the nominal rate if no floor is known) instead of a placeholder.

key.name: monitor-mode
key.description: Which display to report: the primary display, or whichever display is currently updating most.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where the indicator is placed in the top bar.

key.name: debug
key.description: Log measured refresh rates and detected views to the journal. Useful when diagnosing what the extension sees.
